question: What condition is claimed to make practice effective when undertaken for six months with an ochre robe free from bondage?
premises: Practice is to be undertaken for six months.
The practice is associated with an ochre robe free from bondage.
One who does so is the subject of the claim.
inference: One who practices for six months, wearing an ochre robe free from bondage, is the subject of the stated result.
uncertainties: The result of that practice is not stated in this verse alone
plain_english: One who, indeed, should practice for six months wearing an ochre robe free from bondage.
